label: sec:nuclear-binding-intro
html: With the derived atom \mathcal{A}(Z, N) in hand, we identify stable (Z, N) pairs and shell closures. The linear programming deficit profile alone dictates nuclear and atomic stability. Three operator regimes for nuclear binding partition the (Z, N) lattice into torus-knot, Hopf-link, and post-magic regions, reproducing the empirical magic ladder. The valley of stability is the deficit-minimizing locus in (Z, N)-space.
